note: Hand-kept lists for docs/SETTINGS.md (node scripts/settings-map.mjs). top: the settings a studio is likely to change, shown first (the names a real crew's .env sets, plus the main schedule, slot, model and tester knobs; a name ending in _ is a family). passedToCommands: names the harness sets in the environment of a command it runs for you (a game's own script, an engine port's command); they are not settings, so they are not counted or listed with them.

passedToCommands.name: STUDIO_LANE_COMMIT
passedToCommands.note: the lane's commit, for an engine port's preLand command

passedToCommands.name: STUDIO_LANE_DIR
passedToCommands.note: the throwaway checkout of the engine repo the preLand command runs in

passedToCommands.name: STUDIO_ENGINE_REPO
passedToCommands.note: the engine repo's folder, for the preLand command

passedToCommands.name: STUDIO_ENGINE_LANE_DIR
passedToCommands.note: the porter's lane folder, for an engine's quickCheck command

passedToCommands.name: STUDIO_TESTER_RUN_DIR
passedToCommands.note: the tester run folder, for the driver the tester runs (qa/tester-drive.mjs reads it when --run is not given)
